 1                                              COMPLAINT

 2          Plaintiffs Team Rossi Motorsports, LLC (“TRM”), Pieter Rossi, and Alexander Rossi

 3   (collectively “Plaintiffs”) bring this complaint for damages against Michael Gesser (“Gesser”),

 4   Alaska Coffee Roasting of Florida, LLC, and Alaska Coffee Roasting, Inc. (collectively with

 5   Gesser, “Defendants”) and state the following:

 6                                    JURISDICTION AND VENUE

 7      1. This Court has subject matter jurisdiction pursuant to 28 U.S.C. §§ 1332, 1367 and 18

 8   U.S.C. §§ 1030, 1836, and 1964(c)-(d);
 9      2. This Court has personal jurisdiction over Defendants pursuant to Cal. Civ. Proc. Code §
10   410.10 and because Defendants agreed to the personal jurisdiction of this Court in Paragraph 11
11   of the Consulting Agreement described herein. Specifically, Paragraph 11 of the Consulting
12   Agreement between TRM and Defendants states:
13          This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California and any
14          dispute shall be finally resolved by the Superior Court in and for the City and
            County of San Francisco or the United States District Court for the Northern
15          District of California.

16      3. Venue in this court is proper pursuant to 28 U.S.C. § 1391 because a substantial part of the

17   events or omissions giving rise to this action occurred in this district and because Defendants

18   agreed to the venue of this Court in Paragraph 11 of the Consulting Agreement described herein

19   and above.

20                                                  PARTIES

21      4. Plaintiff Team Rossi Motorsports is a California limited liability company doing business

22   in Nevada County, California.

23      5. Plaintiff Pieter Rossi is an individual residing in Nashville, Tennessee.

24      6. Plaintiff Alexander Rossi is an individual residing in Indianapolis, Indiana.

25      7. Plaintiffs are informed and believe and thereon allege that Defendant Michael Gesser is an

26   individual residing in the state of Florida.

27

 1      8. Plaintiffs are informed and believe and thereon allege that Defendant Alaska Coffee

 2   Roasting of Florida, LLC is a Florida limited liability company, with its principal place of business

 3   located in North Miami, Florida.

 4      9. Plaintiffs are informed and believe and thereon allege that Defendant Alaska Coffee

 5   Roasting of Florida, Inc. is an inactive Florida corporation with its principal place of business

 6   located in North Miami, Florida.

 7      10. The names and capacities of Defendants DOES 1-30, inclusive, are unknown to Plaintiffs,

 8   who therefore sue said defendants by such fictitious names. Plaintiffs will amend this complaint
 9   to allege the true names and capacities of said defendants when ascertained. Plaintiffs are informed
10   and believe and thereon allege that each fictitiously named defendant is legally responsible to
11   Plaintiffs for the damages alleged herein.
12                                       STATEMENT OF FACTS

13      11. TRM was formed as a limited liability company in California in 2005 to engage in the

14   business of operating a marketing and consulting firm for the purpose of promoting the racing

15   career of Alexander Rossi.

16      12. Pieter Rossi is the manager and a member of TRM and is the father of Alexander Rossi, a

17   Formula 1 and Indy Car race car driver and proven winner, INDY 500 champion, Daytona 24 Hour

18   winner and Baja 1000 Champion and champion in other forms of racing.

19      13. ARF1 Investment Fund, LLC (“ARF1”) was established in 2009 to provide the necessary

20   funds and resources to fund the costs associated with Alexander Rossi’s racing endeavors and

21   career and to maximize the business commercial and sporting opportunities afforded by Alexander

22   Rossi’s involvement in motorsports.

23      14. TRM has an obligation to pay ARF1 a percentage of Alexander Rossi’s team driver salary,

24   endorsements, image rights and funds generated by merchandise.

25      15. Micheal Gesser is the principal participant in Alaska Coffee Roasting of Florida, LLC, and

26   Alaska Coffee Roasting, Inc. (collectively “ACR”).

27

 1      16. In 2009, Michael Gesser became a member of ARF1 and was provided with 3 Class B

 2   shares of ARF1.

 3      17. On February 28, 2017, ACR and Gesser entered into a final consulting agreement with

 4   TRM to provide consulting and strategic advice to TRM (the “Consulting Agreement”).

 5      18. Gesser was an independent contractor for TRM under the Consulting Agreement and not

 6   an employee.

 7      19. Gesser does not, and did not, have an ownership interest or equity position related to TRM

 8   and has and had no rights or privileges as an owner of TRM.
 9      20. Under the Consulting Agreement, Gesser had a revenue sharing agreement with TRM and
10   received 40 revenue share units which were tied to matching revenue of ARF1.
11      21. Ned Spieker (“Spieker”) was brought in as a consultant to TRM after Gesser, under an
12   amended and restated consulting and marketing agreement and he received revenue share units in
13   TRM as well, which diluted and brought down Gesser’s units in TRM from 40 units to 32 units;
14   but extended the revenue share period for Gesser for an additional 4 years through March 30, 2030.
15      22. Paragraph 3 of the Consulting Agreement states, “TRM and Gesser aim to maximize the
16   business, commercial and sporting opportunities afforded by Alexander Rossi’s involvement in
17   motorsport.”
18      23. Paragraph 7 of the Consulting Agreement states:

19          Gesser shall not disclose to any third party, and shall use his best efforts to prevent
20          the publication and disclosure of any confidential information and trade secrets held
            by ARF1 or TRM unless: any use or disclosure is authorized by TRM or required
21          by law; any such confidential information and/or trade secrets is/are already in, or
            come(s) into the public domain otherwise than through Gesser unauthorized use or
22          disclosure.
23          A copy of the Consulting Agreement is attached hereto as Exhibit 1.
24      24. One Motorsport Marketing and Management, LLC (“One Motorsport”) is a separate
25   company from TRM and both Pieter Rossi and Alexander Rossi are affiliates of One Motorsport.
26      25. MAG Racing Consultants LLC (“MAG Racing”) is a separate company from ACR, and
27   ACR and Michael Gesser are affiliates of MAG Racing.

 5   any and all claims between MAG Racing and One Motorsport.

26   transactions or mismanagement” and “clarify an unexplained discrepancy in the corporation’s
